holidays.name: National Two Different Colored Shoes Day
holidays.description: Today is your official permission slip to walk out the door with one red sneaker and one blue loafer. Mismatched footwear is the dress code, and confidence is the accessory.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance, and its exact origin is unclear. It is said to carry a kind, heartwarming message about embracing what makes us different.
holidays.funFact: Nobody can tell you which shoe is the 'wrong' one, because both of them are right.

holidays.name: National Paranormal Day
holidays.description: A day for ghost hunters, curious skeptics and anyone who has heard a bump in the night. Swap spooky stories, watch a classic haunted-house movie, or wonder who else is in the room.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It has become a favorite among fans of the unexplained.
holidays.funFact: The day lands in early May, far from Halloween, so ghost lovers get a spooky celebration in the middle of spring.

holidays.name: National Lumpy Rug Day
holidays.description: A tongue-in-cheek salute to the rug that never quite lies flat. Embrace your bumpy, wrinkled floor covering, or use the day as an excuse to finally replace it.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It is a playful nod to everyday household annoyances.
holidays.funFact: Rug pads and double-sided rug tape are the classic fixes for a rug that won't stay flat.
